# HTTP and WebSocket reference

217 HTTP operations and 3 WebSockets, in 23 areas, generated from the backend's OpenAPI spec and its route handlers. Start with the [overview](../README.md) for access rules, errors and the WebSocket protocols.

The spec types no successful response, so each one is read from its handler. Of the 217 HTTP operations, 212 have their response shape read from the source, 2 are described by the docstring of the helper that builds the response, 2 are served by libraries (described by hand), and for 1 the reference shows the expression the handler returns (marked "returned as is") next to a link to the handler.

| Area | Operations | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| [`app`](app.md) | 6 | The routes outside `/api`: the backend's own status, Prometheus metrics, Design Center's HTML tools and the pictures social platforms fetch for a post. |
| [`chat`](chat.md) | 10 | Chat router — personas, conversations, and chat turns: the streaming WebSocket (/ws) and a non-streaming /complete. |
| [`community`](community.md) | 12 | Arynwood Community (Arynwood Grove) — the Community page's connection to a Grove. |
| [`deploy`](deploy.md) | 10 | Deploy / Publish router — SSH/SFTP file management for remote web servers. |
| [`dj`](dj.md) | 5 | DJ Toolkit router — launcher + built-in manual for the native Linux DJ/production stack (Mixxx, Ardour, Hydrogen, Surge XT, Vital, Flatseal, Calf/LSP/Dragonfly, Geonkick). |
| [`fs`](fs.md) | 7 | File system exploration API — lets the agent and UI browse and read local files. |
| [`gateway`](gateway.md) | 13 | /api/gateway — the headless gateway's HTTP + WebSocket surface (backend/gateway/). |
| [`images`](images.md) | 4 | Image generation through an endpoint: any OpenAI-compatible images API. |
| [`knowledge`](knowledge.md) | 9 | Knowledge router — learn text, files, URLs and PDFs (through a local Sycamore parse job) into the Qdrant knowledge base, and search it with hybrid vector + lexical ranking. |
| [`lora`](lora.md) | 21 | LoRA router — training projects: source photos, dataset preparation, captions (by hand or Florence-2), SDXL LoRA training through kohya_ss with live progress, and the trained files. |
| [`mcp`](mcp.md) | 3 | MCP proxy router — forwards JSON-RPC calls to configured MCP servers. |
| [`mcp-codebase`](mcp-codebase.md) | 1 | Self-hosted MCP JSON-RPC server exposing read-only (and one approval-gated write) codebase tools to central's tool-calling loop. |
| [`memory`](memory.md) | 8 | Memory router — Arynwood's long-term memories: create, edit, delete, confirm a model-written (provisional) memory, and review proposed revisions. |
| [`models`](models.md) | 2 | Unified model file listing beyond Ollama — SD checkpoints and LoRAs. |
| [`music`](music.md) | 11 | Music Lab router — DB-backed instrument generation, asset library, and job tracking for the song-gen sidecar (ACE-Step / MusicGen). |
| [`ollama`](ollama.md) | 8 | Ollama router — the models on an Ollama server: list, show, pull (streamed progress), unload from VRAM and delete, plus a ping and starting a local `ollama serve`. |
| [`projects`](projects.md) | 5 | Minimal project CRUD (roadmap 4.1) — the connective tissue that lets a conversation, memory, or knowledge source declare which project they belong to. |
| [`servers`](servers.md) | 9 | Servers router — the model servers chat can use (Ollama or OpenAI-compatible): register, edit and ping them, list each one's models, and remember the default. |
| [`social`](social.md) | 13 | Social Media router — OAuth connection management and cross-platform posting. |
| [`studio`](studio.md) | 15 | Studio router — manages MusicStudio sidecars and proxies requests to them. |
| [`system`](system.md) | 7 | System router — health of the services the app uses, GPU information and the GPU job queue, CPU mode, and restarting the backend (source checkouts only). |
| [`tools`](tools.md) | 35 | Tools router — the GPU tool registry and its generators: Stable Diffusion (A1111), text to speech, talking heads, video, background removal, captions and transcription, plus SearXNG search, Qdrant collections, web scraping and the jobs they run. |
| [`video`](video.md) | 6 | Video router — Wan2.1 text-to-video jobs, the video library, edit jobs (trim and join clips, transitions, audio tracks), captions with Whisper, and Creative Commons background music from Jamendo. |
